message:
3 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: binding `textContent` reads `m` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:34: binding `innerHTML` reads `m` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:36: binding `textContent` reads `row` → "Delete the row"
description: The sentence of a `@let` bound by name to `textContent` and to `innerHTML`, and the label of a map a `@let` holds bound two-way to `textContent`, which sets the property as a one-way binding does (measured: each drawn). A drawn property is printed whether it is bound one way or two, and the name stands for what binds it, so the refusal counts three.
